== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The man in black is a tall, muscular individual who appears to be in his forties. He possesses dark skin and dark hair that contains a few gray strands, and he has black eyes. His body is heavily marked by dark tattoos that resemble [[chains]]; these patterns spiral around his arms, torso, and legs, eventually forming a The mask{{!}}mask-like pattern across his face. He is frequently seen wearing black clothing, including cloaks and hoods that often obscure his features, though he sometimes wears a white shirt with the sleeves removed to display his tattooed arms. He is capable of great combat prowess, utilizing swords with ease and moving with a silent, Shadow{{!}}shadow-like presence. While he has at times presented himself with wide, friendly smiles and reassuring words, he has also acted as a silent, menacing attacker using [[black chains]] to strangle others.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|This hooded attacker is shrouded in black clothing. His true essence manifests as a ball of blue-[[white light]] that leaves his garments behind.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], he utilizes a razor-sharp silvery disc weapon with an empty center. He also employs a black chain for strangling and carries a glass horn containing [[water]] within a transparent tube.}}
